title: GEORGE SOROS'S SOROS FUND JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Soros Fund just multiplied its Intel  
(\[INTC\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/INTC/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/INTC/))) stake about 28 times and  
built a $670M put on energy (\[XLE\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/XLE/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/XLE/)))  
— which Q3 13F move stands out?  
  
Tickeron AI uncovered the moves nobody's talking about in the latest  
Soros Fund Management 13F. Intel  
\[INTC\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/INTC/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/INTC/)) was multiplied about 28  
times into a $340M top stock, and Meta  
\[META\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/)) was lifted 595.74%. The  
filing also shows a $670M put on the energy ETF  
\[XLE\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/XLE/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/XLE/)), after they added 444.92%,  
plus a new $328M put on \[XOP\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/XOP/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/XOP/)). They  
sold out of Electronic Arts \[EA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/EA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/EA/)), and  
cut Apple \[AAPL\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/AAPL/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AAPL/)) by 25.66% and  
Nvidia \[NVDA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/)) by 19.33%.

The 28-times Intel increase is the headline, but that $670M energy put  
is huge too. How are you reading this mix of stock adds and index
